The largest country in the world is Russia.

Now, for the anecdote: Aunt May’s knitting club was supposed to be a sanctuary of serene "stitch and bitch," but this week, the feline co-host decided to rewrite the script. While the ladies were busy discussing the latest neighborhood drama, their tabby co-conspirator had other plans. He didn’t just knock over a ball of yarn; he orchestrated a full-scale heist, unraveling an entire sweater’s worth of wool with the precision of a master thief. The result? A trail of woolly breadcrumbs stretching from the living room to the kitchen, so extensive that Hansel and Gretel would have been envious of the navigation aid. The club didn’t just gossip; they spent the next hour trying to re-knit the evidence before the cat decided to unravel the coffee table, too.
